01 / About me

A commercial mind.
A people-first approach.

I connect what a business needs with what owners can offer — and turn that into the right locations on the right terms.

I work on both sides of the table. For occupiers I find, negotiate and renegotiate space; for owners I position and lease buildings. Knowing what a landlord can give and what a tenant really needs is what makes the deals land.

My career runs from developer-side leasing at CTP through CBRE and Savills to leadership roles at 108 Agency and Avison Young, where I now head leasing for Czechia and Slovakia.

Since 2023 I have also been General Manager of Zenwork, a premium coworking brand launched that year in Palác ARA, Prague 1 — a role I hold in parallel with Avison Young.

What interests me next

Taking my experience client-side: leading the real estate portfolio of a large retail network — strategy, new locations, key lease negotiations and a team — in close cooperation with Operations, Finance and Legal. That is why I am applying for Head of Real Estate at BILLA.

04 / Case studies

Challenge.
Role. Outcome.

Selected mandates in detail, then further work. Clients are described generically for confidentiality.

Occupier

Global healthcare provider

Challenge
Keep a clinic network across Czechia and Slovakia in the right premises — often with state-owned landlords — and relocate the Bratislava HQ.
My role
Tenant representation on the HQ move. For the clinics: stay-vs-go analysis, relocations and renegotiations, with regular reporting through a demanding corporate approval process.
Outcome
12+ deals from 2024 to 2026 — repeat business with one client.
Landlord

International insurance group

Challenge
Lease up a 10,000 m² office building (LIFE_C).
My role
Landlord representation: positioning, marketing and tenant negotiations.
Outcome
Approx. 7,000 m² leased through the mandate over about 18–24 months — around 70% of the building’s 10,000 m².
Occupier

International healthcare group

Challenge
Outgrown a small Prague HQ, with a landlord intent on holding the company to the end of its lease.
My role
Took the requirement to the market and made a full exit a credible option. That opened talks with the landlord’s asset manager and a deal within its own portfolio. Also reviews and manages the group’s leases across 10+ European countries.
Outcome
Moved to a larger, more premium office with negotiated savings — and released from the old lease 24 months early.
Landlord

One of the largest private investors in Czechia

Challenge
Lease a five-building office portfolio of c. 28,500 m² in Prague and Karlovy Vary, including a newly refurbished building in Prague 4.
My role
Secured the client for Savills together with the property management team, then took charge of leasing across all five buildings — new lettings and existing tenants.
Outcome
New client onboarded for the firm — and still a Savills client today.
